data.title: Oral Sentence Studio
data.description: Use both new words in one complete sentence of your own.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The happy child sits under a bright sun while building a cozy castle with sand.
acceptedSentences: The happy child plays under the bright sun with a cozy shell.
A bright sky shines down while the child builds a cozy sand castle.
Our cozy friend finds a shell on the bright beach today.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The happy young boy feels proud while building a tall sand castle under the bright sun.
acceptedSentences: The bright sun shines while the happy young boy builds a proud sand castle.
That bright morning makes the boy feel very proud of his castle.
A bright smile shows how proud he is of his big castle.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The cheerful girl plays under the bright sun while listening to the cozy sound of waves near her sea shell.
acceptedSentences: The cheerful girl found a bright shell on the cozy beach.
While splashing in the bright water, the girl felt cozy.
A cozy girl held a bright sea shell by the ocean.
